BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE projection_meta (
  key                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (key = 'default'),
  journal_file              TEXT,
  journal_offset            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_event_id             TEXT,
  last_event_hash           TEXT,
  event_schema              INTEGER NOT NULL,
  projection_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  replay_status             TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at                DATETIME NOT NULL,
  CHECK (journal_offset >= 0),
  CHECK (replay_status IN ('clean', 'catching_up', 'rebuilding', 'error'))
);

CREATE TABLE roles (
  name        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  description TEXT,
  is_human    BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0,
  active      BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1,
  created_at  DATETIME
);

CREATE TABLE issues (
  id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind         TEXT NOT NULL,
  parent_id    TEXT REFERENCES issues(id),
  title        TEXT NOT NULL,
  workflow_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  status       TEXT NOT NULL,
  priority     INTEGER,
  sequence     INTEGER,
  spec_md_path TEXT,
  est_tokens   INTEGER,
  due_date     DATE,
  in_inbox     BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0,
  owner_role   TEXT,
  owner_actor  TEXT,
  created_at   DATETIME,
  updated_at   DATETIME,
  CHECK (kind IN ('epic', 'task', 'subtask')),
  CHECK ((kind = 'epic' AND workflow_id = 'epic-default')
      OR (kind = 'task' AND workflow_id = 'task-default')
      OR (kind = 'subtask' AND workflow_id = 'subtask-default')),
  CHECK ((workflow_id = 'task-default' AND status IN (
          'todo', 'in_progress', 'dev_complete', 'qa_review',
          'qa_block', 'failed_gate', 'qa_pass', 'done', 'cancelled'))
      OR (workflow_id = 'epic-default' AND status IN (
          'todo', 'in_progress', 'wrapped', 'closed', 'cancelled'))
      OR (workflow_id = 'subtask-default' AND status IN (
          'todo', 'in_progress', 'done', 'cancelled'))),
  CHECK (priority IS NULL OR (priority >= 0 AND priority <= 5)),
  CHECK (kind != 'epic' OR est_tokens IS NULL),
  CHECK (sequence IS NULL OR sequence > 0),
  UNIQUE (parent_id, sequence)
);

COMMIT;

BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE epic_metadata (

COMMIT;

BEGIN;
CREATE INDEX idx_concerns_issue_status ON concerns(issue_id, status);

CREATE INDEX idx_triage_issue_created ON triage_events(issue_id, created_at);

CREATE VIEW issues_enriched AS
WITH open_concerns AS (
  SELECT
    i.id AS issue_id,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM concerns c
      WHERE c.issue_id = i.id AND c.status = 'open'
    ) AS n
  FROM issues i
),
latest_triage AS (
  SELECT
    i.id AS issue_id,
    (
      SELECT te.verdict
      FROM triage_events te
      WHERE te.issue_id = i.id
      ORDER BY te.created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS verdict
  FROM issues i
)
SELECT
  i.*,
  (COALESCE(oc.n, 0) > 0) AS concerns_raised,
  COALESCE(oc.n, 0) AS open_concerns_count,
  CASE lt.verdict
    WHEN 'RESUME' THEN 'resumed'
    WHEN 'BLOCK' THEN 'blocked'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS triage_status
FROM issues i
LEFT JOIN open_concerns oc ON oc.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN latest_triage lt ON lt.issue_id = i.id;

COMMIT;

BEGIN;
CREATE TRIGGER issues_parent_kind_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON issues
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN
  (NEW.kind = 'epic' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (
    NEW.kind = 'task'
    AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM issues
      WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic'
    )
  )
  OR (
    NEW.kind = 'subtask'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM issues
      WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'task'
    )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(
    ABORT,
    CASE
      WHEN NEW.kind = 'epic' THEN 'issues: epic parent_id must be NULL'
      WHEN NEW.kind = 'task' THEN 'issues: task parent_id must reference an epic or be NULL'
      ELSE 'issues: subtask parent_id must reference a task'
    END
  );
END;

CREATE TRIGGER issues_parent_kind_guard_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF parent_id ON issues
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN
  (NEW.kind = 'epic' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL)

      SELECT 1

    )

BEGIN

      WHEN NEW.kind = 'epic' THEN 'issues: epic parent_id must be NULL'
      WHEN NEW.kind = 'task' THEN 'issues: task parent_id must reference an epic or be NULL'

    END

END;

CREATE TRIGGER acceptance_criteria_issue_kind_guard_insert

BEGIN;

BEFORE INSERT ON claims
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.ref_type != 'issue'
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'claims: ref_type must be issue in v0.1');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER links_endpoint_scope_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON links
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.from_type NOT IN ('issue', 'requirement')
  OR NEW.to_type NOT IN ('issue', 'requirement')
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'links: endpoint types must be issue or requirement in v0.1');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER links_from_ref_integrity_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON links
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (NEW.from_type = 'issue' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM issues
    WHERE id = NEW.from_id
  ))
  OR (NEW.from_type = 'requirement' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM requirements
    WHERE id = NEW.from_id
  ))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'links: from endpoint must resolve to an existing row');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER links_to_ref_integrity_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON links
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (NEW.to_type = 'issue' AND NOT EXISTS (

  ))
BEGIN

END;

CREATE TRIGGER links_relation_compatibility_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON links
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.from_type IN ('issue', 'requirement')
  AND NEW.to_type IN ('issue', 'requirement')
  AND NOT (
  NEW.relation = 'relates_to'
  OR (
    NEW.relation = 'implements'
    AND NEW.from_type = 'issue'
    AND NEW.to_type = 'requirement'
  )
  OR (
    NEW.relation = 'implemented_by'
    AND NEW.from_type = 'requirement'
    AND NEW.to_type = 'issue'
  )
  OR (
    NEW.relation IN (
      'blocks',
      'blocked_by',
      'duplicates',
      'duplicated_by',
      'supersedes',
      'superseded_by',
      'caused_by',
      'causes',
      'discovered_from',
      'discovered'
    )
    AND NEW.from_type = 'issue'
    AND NEW.to_type = 'issue'
  )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'links: relation/endpoint combination is not allowed in v0.1');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER claims_scope_guard_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF ref_type ON claims

COMMIT;

BEGIN;
CREATE TRIGGER issues_sequence_scheduling_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON issues
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.kind = 'task'
  AND (
    (NEW.parent_id IS NULL AND NEW.sequence IS NOT NULL)
    OR (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM issues
        WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic'
      )
      AND (
        NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM epic_metadata
          WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM epic_metadata
          WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id
            AND scheduling = 'sequential'
            AND NEW.sequence IS NULL
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM epic_metadata
          WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id
            AND scheduling = 'prioritised'
            AND NEW.sequence IS NOT NULL
        )
      )
    )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(
    ABORT,
    CASE
      WHEN NEW.parent_id IS NULL THEN 'issues: unattached task must not have sequence'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM epic_metadata
        WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id
      ) THEN 'issues: task parent epic must have epic_metadata'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM epic_metadata
        WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id AND scheduling = 'sequential'
      ) THEN 'issues: task under sequential epic requires sequence'
      ELSE 'issues: task under prioritised epic must not have sequence'
    END
  );
END;

BEFORE UPDATE OF parent_id, sequence ON issues

        WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic'

          SELECT 1
          FROM epic_metadata
          WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM epic_metadata
          WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id
            AND scheduling = 'sequential'
            AND NEW.sequence IS NULL
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM epic_metadata
          WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id
            AND scheduling = 'prioritised'
            AND NEW.sequence IS NOT NULL

    )

BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(

      WHEN NEW.parent_id IS NULL THEN 'issues: unattached task must not have sequence'

        SELECT 1
        FROM epic_metadata
        WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id
      ) THEN 'issues: task parent epic must have epic_metadata'

        WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id AND scheduling = 'sequential'

END;

{"type":"table","name":"concerns","tbl_name":"concerns","sql":"CREATE TABLE "concerns" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN (
    'issue','envelope','run','review','finding','requirement'
  )),
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scope_json)),
  severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('blocker','major','minor','nit')),
  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  reasoning TEXT NOT NULL,
  references_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(references_json)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open','disposed')),
  disposition_action TEXT CHECK (disposition_action IS NULL OR disposition_action IN (
    'carried-forward','rejected','superseded'
  )),
  disposition_issue_id TEXT REFERENCES issues(id),
  supersedes_concern_id TEXT REFERENCES "concerns"(id),
  supersedes_finding_id TEXT REFERENCES review_findings(id),
  disposition_reason TEXT,
  disposed_actor_id TEXT,
  disposed_at TEXT,
  disposed_event_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  CHECK ((status = 'open'
          AND disposition_action IS NULL AND disposition_reason IS NULL
          AND disposed_actor_id IS NULL AND disposed_at IS NULL
          AND disposed_event_id IS NULL)
      OR (status = 'disposed'
          AND disposition_action IS NOT NULL AND disposition_reason IS NOT NULL
          AND disposed_actor_id IS NOT NULL AND disposed_at IS NOT NULL
          AND disposed_event_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK ((disposition_action IS NULL
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NULL AND supersedes_concern_id IS NULL
          AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
      OR (disposition_action = 'carried-forward'
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_concern_id IS NULL
          AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
      OR (disposition_action = 'rejected'
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NULL AND supersedes_concern_id IS NULL
          AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
      OR (disposition_action = 'superseded'
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NULL
          AND ((supersedes_concern_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
            OR (supersedes_concern_id IS NULL AND supersedes_finding_id IS NOT NULL)))),
  CHECK (supersedes_concern_id IS NULL OR supersedes_concern_id <> id)
)"},

  producer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (producer IN ('fid','activated-actor','human')),
  trust_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trust_source IN (
    'fid-executed','activated-actor','activated-human'
  )),
  target_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(target_repository_json)),
  validity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (validity IN ('valid','invalid')),
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((evidence_type = 'receipt' AND producer = 'fid'
          AND trust_source = 'fid-executed'
          AND receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NULL)
      OR (evidence_type = 'review' AND producer = 'activated-actor'
          AND trust_source = 'activated-actor'
          AND receipt_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NULL)
      OR (evidence_type = 'human-outcome' AND producer = 'human'
          AND trust_source = 'activated-human'
          AND receipt_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NOT NULL))
)"},

{"type":"table","name":"execution_receipts","tbl_name":"execution_receipts","sql":"CREATE TABLE execution_receipts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES execution_attempts(id),
  trust_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trust_source = 'fid-executed'),
  terminal_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (terminal_status IN ('succeeded','failed','timed-out','signaled','spawn-failed','cancelled')),
  exit_code INTEGER,
  signal TEXT,
  timed_out INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (timed_out IN (0, 1)),
  started_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  ended_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  terminal_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(terminal_repository_json)),
  toolchain_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(toolchain_json)),
  output_excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
  output_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  output_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (output_bytes >= 0),
  output_truncated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (output_truncated IN (0, 1)),
  redaction_applied INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (redaction_applied IN (0, 1)),
  rejected_artifacts_json TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (json_valid(rejected_artifacts_json) AND json_type(rejected_artifacts_json) = 'array'),
  CHECK ((terminal_status = 'spawn-failed' AND exit_code IS NULL AND signal IS NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status = 'timed-out' AND timed_out = 1)
      OR (terminal_status = 'signaled' AND exit_code IS NULL AND signal IS NOT NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status IN ('succeeded','failed') AND exit_code IS NOT NULL AND signal IS NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status = 'cancelled' AND timed_out = 0 AND NOT (exit_code IS NOT NULL AND signal IS NOT NULL)))
)"},

{"type":"trigger","name":"acceptance_criteria_issue_kind_guard_insert","tbl_name":"acceptance_criteria","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER acceptance_criteria_issue_kind_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON acceptance_criteria
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM issues
  WHERE id = NEW.issue_id AND kind IN ('task', 'subtask')
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'acceptance_criteria: issue_id must reference a task or subtask');
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"activity_log_ref_integrity_guard_insert","tbl_name":"activity_log","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER activity_log_ref_integrity_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON activity_log
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.ref_type NOT IN ('issue', 'requirement', 'decision')
  OR (NEW.ref_type = 'issue' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.ref_id
  ))
  OR (NEW.ref_type = 'requirement' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM requirement_refs WHERE requirement_id = NEW.ref_id
  ))
  OR (NEW.ref_type = 'decision' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM decision_refs WHERE id = NEW.ref_id
  ))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'activity_log: ref_type/ref_id must resolve to an existing row');
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"epic_metadata_issue_kind_guard_insert","tbl_name":"epic_metadata","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER epic_metadata_issue_kind_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON epic_metadata
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM issues
  WHERE id = NEW.issue_id AND kind = 'epic'
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'epic_metadata: issue_id must reference an epic');
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"issues_kind_immutable","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER issues_kind_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF kind ON issues FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.kind != OLD.kind
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'issues: kind is immutable');
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"issues_parent_kind_guard_insert","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER issues_parent_kind_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON issues FOR EACH ROW WHEN
  (NEW.kind = 'epic' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL) OR
  (NEW.kind = 'task' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic'
  )) OR
  (NEW.kind = 'subtask' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'task'
  ))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, CASE
    WHEN NEW.kind = 'epic' THEN 'issues: epic parent_id must be NULL'
    WHEN NEW.kind = 'task' THEN 'issues: task parent_id must reference an epic or be NULL'
    ELSE 'issues: subtask parent_id must reference a task'
  END);
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"issues_parent_kind_guard_update","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER issues_parent_kind_guard_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF parent_id ON issues FOR EACH ROW WHEN
  (NEW.kind = 'epic' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL) OR
  (NEW.kind = 'task' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic'
  )) OR
  (NEW.kind = 'subtask' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'task'
  ))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, CASE
    WHEN NEW.kind = 'epic' THEN 'issues: epic parent_id must be NULL'
    WHEN NEW.kind = 'task' THEN 'issues: task parent_id must reference an epic or be NULL'
    ELSE 'issues: subtask parent_id must reference a task'
  END);
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"issues_sequence_scheduling_guard_insert","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER issues_sequence_scheduling_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON issues FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.kind = 'task' AND (
  (NEW.parent_id IS NULL AND NEW.sequence IS NOT NULL) OR
  (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic') AND (
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id) OR
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id AND scheduling = 'sequential' AND NEW.sequence IS NULL) OR
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id AND scheduling = 'prioritised' AND NEW.sequence IS NOT NULL)
  ))
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, CASE
    WHEN NEW.parent_id IS NULL THEN 'issues: unattached task must not have sequence'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id) THEN 'issues: task parent epic must have epic_metadata'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id AND scheduling = 'sequential') THEN 'issues: task under sequential epic requires sequence'
    ELSE 'issues: task under prioritised epic must not have sequence'
  END);
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"issues_sequence_scheduling_guard_update","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER issues_sequence_scheduling_guard_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF parent_id, sequence ON issues FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.kind = 'task' AND (
  (NEW.parent_id IS NULL AND NEW.sequence IS NOT NULL) OR
  (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic') AND (
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id) OR
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id AND scheduling = 'sequential' AND NEW.sequence IS NULL) OR
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id AND scheduling = 'prioritised' AND NEW.sequence IS NOT NULL)
  ))
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, CASE
    WHEN NEW.parent_id IS NULL THEN 'issues: unattached task must not have sequence'

{"type":"table","name":"concerns","tbl_name":"concerns","sql":"CREATE TABLE "concerns" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN (
    'issue','envelope','run','review','finding','requirement'
  )),
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scope_json)),
  severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('blocker','major','minor','nit')),
  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  reasoning TEXT NOT NULL,
  references_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(references_json)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open','disposed')),
  disposition_action TEXT CHECK (disposition_action IS NULL OR disposition_action IN (
    'carried-forward','rejected','superseded'
  )),
  disposition_issue_id TEXT REFERENCES issues(id),
  supersedes_concern_id TEXT REFERENCES "concerns"(id),
  supersedes_finding_id TEXT REFERENCES review_findings(id),
  disposition_reason TEXT,
  disposed_actor_id TEXT,
  disposed_at TEXT,
  disposed_event_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  CHECK ((status = 'open'
          AND disposition_action IS NULL AND disposition_reason IS NULL
          AND disposed_actor_id IS NULL AND disposed_at IS NULL
          AND disposed_event_id IS NULL)
      OR (status = 'disposed'
          AND disposition_action IS NOT NULL AND disposition_reason IS NOT NULL
          AND disposed_actor_id IS NOT NULL AND disposed_at IS NOT NULL
          AND disposed_event_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK ((disposition_action IS NULL
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NULL AND supersedes_concern_id IS NULL
          AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
      OR (disposition_action = 'carried-forward'
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_concern_id IS NULL
          AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
      OR (disposition_action = 'rejected'
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NULL AND supersedes_concern_id IS NULL
          AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
      OR (disposition_action = 'superseded'
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NULL
          AND ((supersedes_concern_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
            OR (supersedes_concern_id IS NULL AND supersedes_finding_id IS NOT NULL)))),
  CHECK (supersedes_concern_id IS NULL OR supersedes_concern_id <> id)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"decision_refs","tbl_name":"decision_refs","sql":"CREATE TABLE decision_refs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(source_json)),
  authority_actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  authority_capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(authority_capabilities_json)),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('approved','rejected','deferred')),
  scope_issue_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"deviations","tbl_name":"deviations","sql":"CREATE TABLE deviations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN (
    'issue','envelope','run','review','finding','requirement'
  )),
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  expected TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed TEXT NOT NULL,
  authority_actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  authority_reference TEXT,
  disposition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (disposition IN ('accepted','rejected','pending-decision')),
  reasoning TEXT NOT NULL,
  references_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(references_json)),
  supersedes_deviation_id TEXT REFERENCES deviations(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  CHECK (supersedes_deviation_id IS NULL OR supersedes_deviation_id <> id)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"envelope_authority_grants","tbl_name":"envelope_authority_grants","sql":"CREATE TABLE envelope_authority_grants (
  envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
  actor_selector_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(actor_selector_json)),

  scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scope_json)),
  PRIMARY KEY (envelope_id, revision, ordinal),
  FOREIGN KEY (envelope_id, revision) REFERENCES envelope_revisions(envelope_id, revision)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"envelope_budgets","tbl_name":"envelope_budgets","sql":"CREATE TABLE envelope_budgets (
  envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  budget_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(budget_json)),
  PRIMARY KEY (envelope_id, revision, name),
  FOREIGN KEY (envelope_id, revision) REFERENCES envelope_revisions(envelope_id, revision)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"envelope_issue_selection","tbl_name":"envelope_issue_selection","sql":"CREATE TABLE envelope_issue_selection (
  envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  issue_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id),
  primary_issue INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (primary_issue = 1),
  PRIMARY KEY (envelope_id, revision, issue_id),
  UNIQUE (envelope_id, revision, primary_issue),
  FOREIGN KEY (envelope_id, revision) REFERENCES envelope_revisions(envelope_id, revision)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"envelope_obligations","tbl_name":"envelope_obligations","sql":"CREATE TABLE envelope_obligations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  obligation_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (obligation_type IN ('gate-evidence','review','human-outcome')),
  registration_id TEXT,
  registration_version INTEGER,
  obligation_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(obligation_json)), review_profile TEXT, outcome_class TEXT,
  CHECK ((obligation_type = 'gate-evidence'
          AND registration_id IS NOT NULL AND registration_version IS NOT NULL)
      OR (obligation_type IN ('review','human-outcome')
          AND registration_id IS NULL AND registration_version IS NULL)),
  UNIQUE (envelope_id, revision, id),
  FOREIGN KEY (envelope_id, revision) REFERENCES envelope_revisions(envelope_id, revision),
  FOREIGN KEY (registration_id, registration_version) REFERENCES gate_registrations(id, version)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"envelope_protected_decisions","tbl_name":"envelope_protected_decisions","sql":"CREATE TABLE envelope_protected_decisions (
  envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
  decision_class TEXT NOT NULL,
  required_capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(required_capabilities_json)),
  affected_actions_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(affected_actions_json)),
  PRIMARY KEY (envelope_id, revision, ordinal),
  UNIQUE (envelope_id, revision, decision_class),
  FOREIGN KEY (envelope_id, revision) REFERENCES envelope_revisions(envelope_id, revision)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"envelope_revisions","tbl_name":"envelope_revisions","sql":"CREATE TABLE envelope_revisions (
  envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES work_envelopes(id),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision = 1),
  prior_revision INTEGER CHECK (prior_revision IS NULL),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
  non_goals_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(non_goals_json)),
  risk_result_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(risk_result_json)),
  repository_scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(repository_scope_json)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft','active','completed')),
  created_actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  approved_actor_id TEXT,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  activated_at DATETIME,
  completed_at DATETIME,
  PRIMARY KEY (envelope_id, revision)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"envelope_sources","tbl_name":"envelope_sources","sql":"CREATE TABLE envelope_sources (
  envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
  source_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(source_json)),
  PRIMARY KEY (envelope_id, revision, ordinal),
  FOREIGN KEY (envelope_id, revision) REFERENCES envelope_revisions(envelope_id, revision)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"epic_metadata","tbl_name":"epic_metadata","sql":"CREATE TABLE epic_metadata (
  issue_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES issues(id),
  scheduling    TEXT NOT NULL,
  brief_md_path TEXT,
  target_start  DATE,
  target_end    DATE
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"evidence_artifact_links","tbl_name":"evidence_artifact_links","sql":"CREATE TABLE evidence_artifact_links (
  evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_records(id),
  artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES referenced_artifacts(id),
  required_material INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (required_material IN (0, 1)),
  PRIMARY KEY (evidence_id, artifact_id)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"evidence_records","tbl_name":"evidence_records","sql":"CREATE TABLE "evidence_records" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  obligation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES envelope_obligations(id),
  evidence_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (evidence_type IN ('receipt','review','human-outcome')),
  receipt_id TEXT REFERENCES execution_receipts(id),
  review_id TEXT REFERENCES review_records(id),
  human_outcome_id TEXT REFERENCES human_outcomes(id),
  producer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (producer IN ('fid','activated-actor','human')),
  trust_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trust_source IN (
    'fid-executed','activated-actor','activated-human'
  )),
  target_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(target_repository_json)),
  validity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (validity IN ('valid','invalid')),
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((evidence_type = 'receipt' AND producer = 'fid'
          AND trust_source = 'fid-executed'
          AND receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NULL)
      OR (evidence_type = 'review' AND producer = 'activated-actor'
          AND trust_source = 'activated-actor'
          AND receipt_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NULL)
      OR (evidence_type = 'human-outcome' AND producer = 'human'
          AND trust_source = 'activated-human'
          AND receipt_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NOT NULL))
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"execution_attempts","tbl_name":"execution_attempts","sql":"CREATE TABLE execution_attempts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  registration_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  registration_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  obligation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES envelope_obligations(id),
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  start_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(start_repository_json)),
  resolved_policy_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  producer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (producer = 'fid'),
  started_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (registration_id, registration_version) REFERENCES gate_registrations(id, version)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"execution_receipts","tbl_name":"execution_receipts","sql":"CREATE TABLE execution_receipts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES execution_attempts(id),
  trust_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trust_source = 'fid-executed'),
  terminal_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (terminal_status IN ('succeeded','failed','timed-out','signaled','spawn-failed','cancelled')),
  exit_code INTEGER,
  signal TEXT,
  timed_out INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (timed_out IN (0, 1)),
  started_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  ended_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  terminal_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(terminal_repository_json)),
  toolchain_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(toolchain_json)),
  output_excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
  output_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  output_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (output_bytes >= 0),
  output_truncated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (output_truncated IN (0, 1)),
  redaction_applied INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (redaction_applied IN (0, 1)),
  rejected_artifacts_json TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (json_valid(rejected_artifacts_json) AND json_type(rejected_artifacts_json) = 'array'),
  CHECK ((terminal_status = 'spawn-failed' AND exit_code IS NULL AND signal IS NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status = 'timed-out' AND timed_out = 1)
      OR (terminal_status = 'signaled' AND exit_code IS NULL AND signal IS NOT NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status IN ('succeeded','failed') AND exit_code IS NOT NULL AND signal IS NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status = 'cancelled' AND timed_out = 0 AND NOT (exit_code IS NOT NULL AND signal IS NOT NULL)))
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"finding_dispositions","tbl_name":"finding_dispositions","sql":"CREATE TABLE finding_dispositions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  finding_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES review_findings(id),
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('addressed','resolved','inapplicable')),
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  claim_id TEXT REFERENCES claims(id),
  qualifying_review_id TEXT REFERENCES review_records(id),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  disposed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((action = 'addressed'
          AND claim_id IS NOT NULL AND qualifying_review_id IS NULL)
      OR (action IN ('resolved','inapplicable')
          AND claim_id IS NULL AND qualifying_review_id IS NOT NULL)),
  UNIQUE (finding_id, claim_id)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"gate_registrations","tbl_name":"gate_registrations","sql":"CREATE TABLE gate_registrations (
  id TEXT NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),
  activation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  definition_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  definition_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  definition_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  binding_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scope_json)),
  policy_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(policy_json)),
  authorization_provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id, version),
  UNIQUE (definition_digest, binding_digest),
  FOREIGN KEY (activation_id, definition_id, definition_version)
    REFERENCES activation_gate_definitions(activation_id, definition_id, definition_version)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"human_outcomes","tbl_name":"human_outcomes","sql":"CREATE TABLE human_outcomes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  activation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES kit_activations(id),
  activation_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (activation_version > 0),
  profile_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN (
    'issue','envelope','run','review','finding','requirement'
  )),
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  result TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (result IN (
    'approved','rejected','changes-required','acknowledged'
  )),
  scope_issue_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id),
  reasoning TEXT NOT NULL,
  references_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(references_json)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"idempotency_results","tbl_name":"idempotency_results","sql":"CREATE TABLE idempotency_results (
  operation_scope TEXT NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  result_entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  result_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  aggregate_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (aggregate_sequence > 0),
  result_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(result_json)),
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, request_field_digests_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(request_field_digests_json)),
  PRIMARY KEY (operation_scope, idempotency_key)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"issue_labels","tbl_name":"issue_labels","sql":"CREATE TABLE issue_labels (
  issue_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id),
  label    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES labels(name),
  PRIMARY KEY (issue_id, label)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"issues","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TABLE "issues" (
  id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind         TEXT NOT NULL,
  parent_id    TEXT REFERENCES issues(id),
  title        TEXT NOT NULL,
  workflow_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflows(id),
  status       TEXT NOT NULL,
  priority     INTEGER,
  sequence     INTEGER,
  spec_md_path TEXT,
  owner_role   TEXT,
  owner_actor  TEXT,
  created_at   DATETIME,
  updated_at   DATETIME, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  CHECK (kind IN ('epic', 'task', 'subtask')),
  CHECK (priority IS NULL OR (priority >= 0 AND priority <= 5)),
  CHECK (sequence IS NULL OR sequence > 0),
  UNIQUE (parent_id, sequence),
  FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id, status)
    REFERENCES workflow_states(workflow_id, state)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"kit_activations","tbl_name":"kit_activations","sql":"CREATE TABLE kit_activations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  prior_activation_id TEXT REFERENCES kit_activations(id),
  kit_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
  backend_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
  phase INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (phase > 0),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('prepared','staged','committed','finalized','aborted','superseded')),
  point_of_no_return INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (point_of_no_return IN (0, 1)),
  direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction = 'activate'),
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL
, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version > 0))"},
{"type":"table","name":"labels","tbl_name":"labels","sql":"CREATE TABLE labels (
  name        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  colour      TEXT,
  description TEXT
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"links","tbl_name":"links","sql":"CREATE TABLE links (
  from_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
  from_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  relation   TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME,
  PRIMARY KEY (from_type, from_id, relation, to_type, to_id)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"projection_meta","tbl_name":"projection_meta","sql":"CREATE TABLE projection_meta (
  key                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (key = 'default'),
  journal_file              TEXT,
  journal_offset            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_event_id             TEXT,
  last_event_hash           TEXT,
  event_schema              INTEGER NOT NULL,
  projection_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  replay_status             TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at                DATETIME NOT NULL,
  CHECK (journal_offset >= 0),
  CHECK (replay_status IN ('clean', 'catching_up', 'rebuilding', 'error'))
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"receipt_artifacts","tbl_name":"receipt_artifacts","sql":"CREATE TABLE receipt_artifacts (
  receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES execution_receipts(id),
  artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES referenced_artifacts(id),
  declared_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (receipt_id, artifact_id)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"referenced_artifacts","tbl_name":"referenced_artifacts","sql":"CREATE TABLE referenced_artifacts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  media_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes >= 0),
  retention_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (retention_class = 'evidence'),
  availability TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (availability IN ('available','missing')),
  location_policy TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (location_policy = 'content-addressed'),
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  expires_at DATETIME
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"requirement_issue_links","tbl_name":"requirement_issue_links","sql":"CREATE TABLE requirement_issue_links (
  requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  issue_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id),
  relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relation IN ('implements','verifies','relates-to')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (requirement_id, issue_id, relation)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"requirement_refs","tbl_name":"requirement_refs","sql":"CREATE TABLE requirement_refs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(source_json)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active','superseded','withdrawn')),
  superseded_by_id TEXT REFERENCES requirement_refs(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((status = 'superseded' AND superseded_by_id IS NOT NULL)
      OR (status IN ('active','withdrawn') AND superseded_by_id IS NULL)),
  CHECK (superseded_by_id IS NULL OR superseded_by_id <> id)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"review_findings","tbl_name":"review_findings","sql":"CREATE TABLE review_findings (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES review_records(id),
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN (
    'issue','envelope','run','review','finding','requirement'
  )),
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scope_json)),
  severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('blocker','major','minor','nit')),
  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  blocking INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (blocking IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((severity IN ('blocker','major') AND blocking = 1)
      OR (severity IN ('minor','nit') AND blocking = 0))
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"review_records","tbl_name":"review_records","sql":"CREATE TABLE review_records (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runs(id),
  issue_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id),
  envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  envelope_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  profile TEXT NOT NULL,
  repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(repository_json)),
  coverage_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(coverage_json)),
  verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('pass','changes-required','blocked')),
  evidence_refs_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(evidence_refs_json)),
  receipt_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(receipt_ids_json)),
  independence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (independence = 'distinct-actor'),
  recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  FOREIGN KEY (envelope_id, envelope_revision) REFERENCES envelope_revisions(envelope_id, revision)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"run_budget_bindings","tbl_name":"run_budget_bindings","sql":"CREATE TABLE run_budget_bindings (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  budget_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(budget_json)),
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, name)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"run_observations","tbl_name":"run_observations","sql":"CREATE TABLE run_observations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('liveness','checkpoint')),
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  observation_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(observation_json)),
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"run_recoveries","tbl_name":"run_recoveries","sql":"CREATE TABLE run_recoveries (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  prior_run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runs(id),
  successor_run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runs(id),
  prior_claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES claims(id),
  successor_claim_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES claims(id),
  observation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_observations(id),
  reconciliation_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(reconciliation_json)),
  adopted_paths_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(adopted_paths_json)),
  authority_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(authority_json)),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  CHECK (prior_run_id <> successor_run_id),
  CHECK (prior_claim_id <> successor_claim_id)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"run_runtime","tbl_name":"run_runtime","sql":"CREATE TABLE run_runtime (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(id),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),
  executor_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  obligation_id TEXT REFERENCES envelope_obligations(id)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"runs","tbl_name":"runs","sql":"CREATE TABLE runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  issue_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id),
  envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  envelope_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "claims"(id),
  claim_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  start_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(start_repository_json)),
  terminal_repository_json TEXT CHECK (terminal_repository_json IS NULL OR json_valid(terminal_repository_json)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active','succeeded','failed','abandoned','interrupted')),
  started_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  ended_at DATETIME,
  FOREIGN KEY (envelope_id, envelope_revision) REFERENCES envelope_revisions(envelope_id, revision)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"stop_resolutions","tbl_name":"stop_resolutions","sql":"CREATE TABLE stop_resolutions (
  stop_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES stops(id),
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  fact_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  resolved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"stops","tbl_name":"stops","sql":"CREATE TABLE stops (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN ('run','envelope','activation')),
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (code IN (
    'executor-liveness-unknown','recovery-state-conflict','budget-exhausted',
    'budget-data-unavailable','activation-incomplete','capability-unavailable',
    'operator-stop','review-rework-exhausted','protected-decision-required',
    'human-outcome-required'
  )),

{"type":"table","name":"concerns","tbl_name":"concerns","sql":"CREATE TABLE "concerns" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN (
    'issue','envelope','run','review','finding','requirement'
  )),
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scope_json)),
  severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('blocker','major','minor','nit')),
  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  reasoning TEXT NOT NULL,
  references_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(references_json)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open','disposed')),
  disposition_action TEXT CHECK (disposition_action IS NULL OR disposition_action IN (
    'carried-forward','rejected','superseded'
  )),
  disposition_issue_id TEXT REFERENCES issues(id),
  supersedes_concern_id TEXT REFERENCES "concerns"(id),
  supersedes_finding_id TEXT REFERENCES review_findings(id),
  disposition_reason TEXT,
  disposed_actor_id TEXT,
  disposed_at TEXT,
  disposed_event_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  CHECK ((status = 'open'
          AND disposition_action IS NULL AND disposition_reason IS NULL
          AND disposed_actor_id IS NULL AND disposed_at IS NULL
          AND disposed_event_id IS NULL)
      OR (status = 'disposed'
          AND disposition_action IS NOT NULL AND disposition_reason IS NOT NULL
          AND disposed_actor_id IS NOT NULL AND disposed_at IS NOT NULL
          AND disposed_event_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK ((disposition_action IS NULL
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NULL AND supersedes_concern_id IS NULL
          AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
      OR (disposition_action = 'carried-forward'
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_concern_id IS NULL
          AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
      OR (disposition_action = 'rejected'
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NULL AND supersedes_concern_id IS NULL
          AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
      OR (disposition_action = 'superseded'
          AND disposition_issue_id IS NULL
          AND ((supersedes_concern_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_finding_id IS NULL)
            OR (supersedes_concern_id IS NULL AND supersedes_finding_id IS NOT NULL)))),
  CHECK (supersedes_concern_id IS NULL OR supersedes_concern_id <> id)
)"},

{"type":"table","name":"evidence_records","tbl_name":"evidence_records","sql":"CREATE TABLE "evidence_records" (

  receipt_id TEXT REFERENCES execution_receipts(id),
  review_id TEXT REFERENCES review_records(id),
  human_outcome_id TEXT REFERENCES human_outcomes(id),
  producer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (producer IN ('fid','activated-actor','human')),
  trust_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trust_source IN (
    'fid-executed','activated-actor','activated-human'
  )),
  target_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(target_repository_json)),
  validity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (validity IN ('valid','invalid')),

  CHECK ((evidence_type = 'receipt' AND producer = 'fid'
          AND trust_source = 'fid-executed'
          AND receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NULL)
      OR (evidence_type = 'review' AND producer = 'activated-actor'
          AND trust_source = 'activated-actor'
          AND receipt_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NULL)
      OR (evidence_type = 'human-outcome' AND producer = 'human'
          AND trust_source = 'activated-human'
          AND receipt_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NOT NULL))

{"type":"table","name":"execution_receipts","tbl_name":"execution_receipts","sql":"CREATE TABLE execution_receipts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES execution_attempts(id),
  trust_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trust_source = 'fid-executed'),
  terminal_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (terminal_status IN ('succeeded','failed','timed-out','signaled','spawn-failed','cancelled')),
  exit_code INTEGER,
  signal TEXT,
  timed_out INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (timed_out IN (0, 1)),
  started_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  ended_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  terminal_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(terminal_repository_json)),
  toolchain_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(toolchain_json)),
  output_excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
  output_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  output_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (output_bytes >= 0),
  output_truncated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (output_truncated IN (0, 1)),
  redaction_applied INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (redaction_applied IN (0, 1)),
  rejected_artifacts_json TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (json_valid(rejected_artifacts_json) AND json_type(rejected_artifacts_json) = 'array'),
  CHECK ((terminal_status = 'spawn-failed' AND exit_code IS NULL AND signal IS NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status = 'timed-out' AND timed_out = 1)
      OR (terminal_status = 'signaled' AND exit_code IS NULL AND signal IS NOT NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status IN ('succeeded','failed') AND exit_code IS NOT NULL AND signal IS NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status = 'cancelled' AND timed_out = 0 AND NOT (exit_code IS NOT NULL AND signal IS NOT NULL)))
)"},
